'''Sartinaynian City''' was the capital of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
It is unclear if this city is simply renamed [[Ravelin]], which was the capital of Bastion in [[41 ABY]], or is a completely different city altogether.
